ask.cache_hint: A question already answered on this unchanged forest is served from the store instantly, and without paying the model again. Off, this ask buys a fresh run and replaces the stored one.
ask.evidence_hint: Every id below was actually read to produce this answer. Click one to open it.
ask.ex3: Summarise what is under the largest branch.
ask.graph_hint: Draws where the answer came from, in a panel under the reply. On a sweep it reads the map once and runs the same retrieval alongside the answer, while the model writes; when it hops, the panel fills as the hops land. Neither delays the reply, and the figure beside the stages is the real one.
ask.history_bound: Keeps the last {n} runs of this forest, dropping the oldest first.
ask.history_empty: Every question asked here is kept in this browser, so you can come back to one and compare it with a fresh answer.
ask.history_local: Kept in this browser, on this machine only never sent to the Station, and discarded when you sign out.
ask.history_unavailable: This browser is not keeping runs: storage is unavailable (a private window, or storage turned off). Answers are unaffected.
ask.hops_hint: Instead of one deterministic sweep, the model holds the primitives and navigates locate, look, move, pick until it can answer. Costs one model call per hop.
ask.hybrid_hint: Fuses the vector layer into the search that finds the material. Off by default: on our corpora it pushed the right node off first place. Turn it on to measure that on yours.
ask.limits: Answers are read from node text. A question whose answer is an aggregate over dataset rows is refused rather than guessed use Data for those.
ask.material_hint: The summary decides which node; the body is what the model was given. These are the exact snippets and sections.
ask.material_outline: Outline only the body exceeded the per-node budget
ask.no_model: No model is bound to this forest for answering yet.
ask.nothing: Retrieval found nothing inside your scope for that question.
ask.path_clocks: Per hop: the forest call + the model turn that chose it.
ask.placeholder: Ask anything about what is in this forest…
ask.reply_hint: How long the model may answer. Auto keeps the forest's own setting; your choice is remembered in this browser.
ask.restored_hint: A record of a call already made nothing was re-run. Ask again to compare it with a fresh answer.
ask.stage_entry: entry search over curated metadata and bodies
ask.stage_walk: hopping: one model call per decision
ask.stage_write: writing the answer from what was read
ask.sub: Retrieval runs inside your scope first; only then does the bound model read what it found.
ask.title: Ask the forest
ask.trail_empty: Ask something and the path is drawn here.
ask.trail_line_step: Monkey: the step into the opened file
ask.trail_line_walk: Monkey: where it walked, hop by hop
ask.trail_sub: Where this question went, on the forest it came out of.
ask.trail_view_hint: Scroll to zoom, drag to pan, double-click to fit
ask.trail_waiting: Searching — the first stages appear before the reply does.
ask.working_hops: Foraging searching, reading, deciding where next…
